Description: This workout has a focus on your arms, abs, and glutes. The moves include side planks, butterfly bridges, and variations of pushups.
Detailed Moves:
7 moves • 2 rounds

Order of moves in each round:

1. 1-2-3-4-5-6-7
2. 1-3-2-4-5-6-7

Moves

1. Frog (start at high diagonal, then lower legs more)
2. Frog with leg lower and lift
3. Neck pull (start with knees bent and holding thighs, then legs straight and reaching forward)
4. Butterfly bridge
5. Kneeling side kick diagonal high kick up (kneeling side plank only, then add kick)
6. Spiderman push-ups (3 sets, set 1 kneeling, set 2 and 3 full plank)
   1. After set 1, tall kneeling wrist circles
   2. After round 1, set 2, dynamic chest openers (swinging arms open and closed/hugging)
   3. After round 2, set 2, diagonal chest openers (alternating arms)
   4. After set 3, down-dog/pike, hop, and roll up to standing
      1. After the 3 sets, downdog/pike, hop and roll up to standing
7. Standing tick tocks
8. Cooldown • Overhead tricep stretches, Interlaced/clasped hands reaching back and opening chest

Description: This workout has exercises for your entire body, including skaters, side planks, and variations of sit-ups.
Detailed Moves:
1. Nod and curl with coordination (one arm tap knee, opposite arm reach out in half T, alternating sides)
2. California (half-roll back, rotate and circle front arm back, alternating sides)
3. Seated twist with hands on back of head
4. Supine hip abduction (lying down with leg up, open leg/drop, one side at a time with other leg down)
5. Side lying series
   1. Inner thigh circles
   2. Side lying triceps pushup
   3. Side lying toe taps forward and back (in an arc)
   4. Clamshell variation (bottom leg straight, top leg bent rotating from parallel to perpendicular)
   5. Elbow side plank with lift and tap forward and back (kneeling, then full side plank)
6. Skater
   1. Hands on hips, lifting opposite leg
   2. T-arms, hinge and rotate and reach hand down and towards shin
7. Curtsy side bend stretch (reaching hand overhead and side bending, back foot has ankle rolled down)
Name: Pilates with Marimba • Ep83

Description: This workout has exercises for your abs, back, and hips. The moves include leg circles, criss-cross, and “swimming.”
Detailed Moves:
1. The hundred (tabletop, then legs extended on diagonal)
2. Coordination (hands overhead legs in tabletop, reach hands forward and legs out on diagonal, then open up opposite arm/leg to the side, alternating sides then reset; set 2 stay in nod and curl position)
3. Single leg circles (non-working leg down/bent, then non-working leg flat
4. Palm touch scissors (opposite leg on the ground, then nod and curl with both legs straight and up)
5. Crisscross (start with legs down, then full crisscross)
6. Spine stretch forward (start with bent knees and hands on thighs and rounding forward, then straight legs and reaching forward)
7. Corkscrew (legs bent, then legs straight)
8. Saw
9. Single leg kick (head down on hands, then one fist in hand in a back extension, alternating kicks)
10. Swimming (slow and touching ground, then hovering fast)
11. Child's pose
12. Down dog to up dog (starting kneeling/knees bent, then full downdog) • 3 sets (wrist circles between sets)
13. Walk feet to hands and roll up
